meta.name: The Golden Spoon
meta.description: Would you trade your poor but loving family for a life of riches? When Seung Cheon gets his hands on a magical spoon that allows him to switch lives with his rich best friend, he thinks it’s a no-brainer. But life-altering decisions are always accompanied by a sense of doubt, and with only three chances to change his mind, Seung Cheon has to decide which of his two possible futures is worth keeping.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Dirt spoon' Seung-cheon gets a hold of a mysterious golden spoon that can change his parents.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Seung-cheon becomes Hwang Tae-yong with the spoon, but the real Tae-yong finds himself in trouble.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Seung-cheon learns that there is a rule about the golden spoon that the old woman did not tell him.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Seung-cheon is worried that he might be found out, and a third person appears and puts him in danger.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Seung-cheon decides to return to "Lee Seung-cheon" after hearing the news that Cheol might die.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Despite confirming his love with Ju-hee, Seung-cheon decides to return to Hwang Tae-yong.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Seung-cheon discovers more secrets about the real Tae-yong while helping his poor family.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Seung-cheon is shocked that Tae-yong may have killed President Na, and that he may take all the blame.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Seung-cheon returns to Korea ten years later and is reunited with Ju-hee.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Seung-cheon agrees to be interviewed by Ju-hee, only because he wants to see her again.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Ju-hee and Seung-cheon grow closer, and Tae-yong is getting closer to the secret of the golden spoon.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Tae-yong meets the old woman. After learning everything, he decides to get his old life back.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Seung-cheon returns to his original self, and contemplates how to return to Hwang Tae-yong.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Hyeon-do hides the fact that he also used a golden spoon and welcomes Seung-cheon as "Hwang Tae-yong".

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Through the death of Cheol, Seung-cheon regrets his past choices and makes a new resolution.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Seung-cheon, who has become a suspect in the murder, struggles to find a way to convict Hyeon-do.
